mandatory_constraint.requirement: zero cost to maintainer is mandatory
configuration: owner-created GitHub App; no purchased Marketplace subscription
free-access catalog AI model allowlist; no paid inference fallback
bounded quotas, retries and refusal; no automatic plan upgrade or credits

proposed_notices.title: Managed service
proposed_notices.proposed_text: This managed reporting and hosted AI route is enabled only after its zero-cost configuration is verified. It must not purchase credits, upgrade a plan or use a paid fallback. Free limits can make requests unavailable; free access is not unlimited or guaranteed indefinitely.
proposed_notices.display_only_after_owning_implementation: Final owner free-plan/model/resource configuration verified; no paid fallback/upgrade paths implemented; availability statement remains conditional.

proposed_notices.title: Public report service
proposed_notices.proposed_text: The verified managed route can file a limited technical summary on the public spaCR GitHub repository without your own GitHub account. Public issues can be indexed and copied and cannot be reliably unpublished. The route must remain zero-cost to the maintainer; if its free limits prevent filing, it queues or refuses the request instead of charging.
proposed_notices.display_only_after_owning_implementation: Strict typed summary actually excludes raw logs/settings/paths/personal text; owner zero-cost gate and independent report quotas implemented. Queue only if explicitly permitted by bounded storage/retry policy.

proposed_notices.title: Hosted diagnosis
proposed_notices.proposed_text: The verified hosted route sends a limited technical summary to the cloud AI service without requiring your own AI account. Its answer is generated advice, not a verified diagnosis, and no command is run automatically. The route must remain zero-cost to the maintainer. If free AI capacity is unavailable, it queues or refuses the request instead of using paid inference. Public issue filing is a separate action with its own limits.
proposed_notices.display_only_after_owning_implementation: Hosted selection/actual new request; typed input/privacy disclosure and opt-out; verified free model allowlist, atomic quota enforcement and no paid fallback. Reused advice does not imply a new transfer.

proposed_notices.title: Hosted chat
proposed_notices.proposed_text: Hosted chat sends the question and the conversation context you explicitly include to the cloud service. That text may contain personal or confidential information; review it before sending. Prior CLI conversations, raw logs and settings are not transferred automatically. The hosted route must remain zero-cost to the maintainer and will queue or refuse requests when free capacity is exhausted.
proposed_notices.display_only_after_owning_implementation: Hosted mode selected, explicit context preview/consent and transfer boundary implemented, zero-cost verified, no arbitrary-text anonymity claim or automatic raw CLI history import.

proposed_notices.title: Free AI limit reached
proposed_notices.proposed_text: The hosted AI service has reached its free limit. This request was refused and no new answer is available. spaCR will not buy credits, upgrade a plan or select paid inference automatically. You can try again when free capacity is available. Public reporting remains separate and may still be available within its own limits.
proposed_notices.display_only_after_owning_implementation: Confirmed quota refusal without successful inference; no successful queued request promised; independent report route status actually checked. Do not assert all transport was cancelled.

proposed_notices.title: AI request queued
proposed_notices.proposed_text: Free AI capacity is currently unavailable. Your request is queued under the stated storage and retry policy; it has not completed. No paid fallback or automatic upgrade will be used. You can remove the queued request before another attempt starts; removing it cannot undo data already sent in an earlier attempt.
proposed_notices.display_only_after_owning_implementation: Actual permitted bounded queue exists with disclosed content/location/retention/deletion and retry limits; consent valid; server/client request identity reconciled. Never imply raw inputs or CLI history automatically saved.

proposed_notices.title: Report not accepted
proposed_notices.proposed_text: The managed reporting service has reached its free limit and did not accept this report for filing. No paid fallback or automatic upgrade will be used. You can retry later. Hosted AI has separate limits and does not establish that a public issue was filed.
proposed_notices.display_only_after_owning_implementation: Explicit authoritative quota rejection proves no accepted filing for this attempt. Network timeout/unknown result must use ZC09 instead.

proposed_notices.title: Report queued
proposed_notices.proposed_text: The report is queued under the stated storage and retry policy because free reporting capacity is unavailable. It has not been filed by this queued attempt. No paid fallback or automatic upgrade will be used. You can remove it before another filing attempt starts; removal cannot retract an issue already published by an earlier attempt.
proposed_notices.display_only_after_owning_implementation: Actual permitted bounded summary queue; no submission yet for queued attempt; prior attempts reconciled/deduplicated. Queue retention and cancellation disclosed and implemented.

proposed_notices.title: Report result unknown
proposed_notices.proposed_text: We could not confirm whether the reporting service accepted this request. Do not treat this as a filed issue or as proof that nothing was sent. spaCR must check the request identity before retrying; it will not switch to a paid service or upgrade a plan.
proposed_notices.display_only_after_owning_implementation: Actual indeterminate transport/outcome; reconciliation mechanism implemented. Do not claim complete anonymity, cancellation or guaranteed future filing.

proposed_notices.title: Zero-cost configuration unverified
proposed_notices.proposed_text: Managed public reporting and hosted AI are unavailable because the service’s zero-cost configuration has not been verified. The route stays disabled; spaCR will not select a paid replacement or upgrade a plan automatically. Existing CLI providers are separate options with their own account requirements and terms.
proposed_notices.display_only_after_owning_implementation: Owner configuration verification absent/stale/failed; application actually keeps managed route disabled. No deployment/free-plan certification implied.

proposed_notices.title: Zero-cost route unavailable
proposed_notices.proposed_text: The managed service is unavailable because its current configuration cannot satisfy the zero-cost requirement. The route stays disabled instead of buying credits, upgrading a plan or using paid inference. This does not change your separately configured CLI provider.
proposed_notices.display_only_after_owning_implementation: Actual plan/model/limit check establishes incompatibility; preserve unrelated user configuration and do not silently alter other services.

proposed_notices.title: No automatic charges
proposed_notices.proposed_text: For the verified managed route, free-quota exhaustion must queue or refuse work. spaCR will not automatically buy credits, upgrade plans, purchase hosting or domains, or invoke a paid fallback. Existing CLI providers use their own accounts and terms and are not part of this managed-route commitment.
proposed_notices.display_only_after_owning_implementation: Owning implementation/account configuration actually enforces these boundaries. This notice is not a financial guarantee for arbitrary user CLI/provider accounts or future changed terms.

proposed_notices.title: Existing CLI provider
proposed_notices.proposed_text: This option uses your selected user-owned CLI provider and its account or subscription settings. Its deployment, transport and billing terms are separate from spaCR’s managed zero-cost route. spaCR does not switch to it automatically when hosted free capacity is exhausted. Review what error text or conversation context will be handed to the selected CLI.
proposed_notices.display_only_after_owning_implementation: Existing CLI selected explicitly, correct provider account/terms disclosure; no claim every CLI remote/account-free/no-charge and no automatic quota fallback.

requirements_before_use: Owner verifies actual zero-cost accounts/plans/resources/model allowlist; no subscriptions/credits/paid fallback/domain/GPU rental/automatic upgrades. No price research or new verification performed in this receipt.
Home approves exact future English only after client/relay behavior lands; placeholders must be resolved by implemented policy, not prose.
Atomic shared quotas/retry/deduplication must reject or queue rather than charge. Ordinary report path independent of AIquota, subject to own limits.
Queue notices require actual disclosed bounded retention, consent and removal rules; refusal/unknown outcomes remain distinct. No retry after unknown submission until identity reconciled.
Identify actual cloud/relay data destination, operational metadata/retention, explicit opt-outs and action-specific cancellation. No zero-retention/anonymity promise from zero cost.
Keep optional existing CLI accounts and pricing/transport terms separate. Do not automatically select them as paid fallback or alter unrelated configured services.
No translations/source/catalog changes during freeze. These notices are unapproved drafts and do not certify current service free or deployed.
